item.title: Tyler Bates is Jumping Ship from Marilyn Manson’s Touring Lineup to Focus on the Big Screen
item.description: It looks like the Marilyn Manson live experience is going to look a little different moving forward. Tyler Bates, the multi-instrumentalist mastermind who has been a cornerstone of Manson’s sound for the better part of a decade, has officially decided to hang up his touring boots.
